create_CoreferenceCustom: create a CoreferenceCustom model instance with vocab, embedders, encoders, and coreference resolution hyperparameters
run_CoreferenceCustom_forward: run the forward pass of CoreferenceCustom to predict coreference antecedents and compute loss from spans and text tensors
get_CoreferenceCustom_metrics: get detailed coreference resolution metrics including B3, MUC, CEAFE scores and mention recall from the model
build_CoreferenceCustom_eval_gold: build a CoreferenceCustom model configured to evaluate with gold mentions instead of predicted mentions
review_CoreferenceCustom: review the CoreferenceCustom class that extends CoreferenceResolver with modified scoring and gold mention evaluation support
